method: Saved raw element face-envelope scalars are piecewise constant. Fixed-point values use containing elements (mean and range if on an edge). Fixed-region means use exact polygon/rectangle intersection areas. No nodal smoothing or solver evaluation.
quality_note: Edge-length ratio and Jacobian condition are independent diagnostics, not the proprietary ANSYS aspect-ratio definition. Scaled corner Jacobian includes corner angle; Jacobian orientation is normalized to the element polygon orientation.
